paper.title_en: Subleading Chern-Simons soft factors in perturbative de Sitter
paper.abstract_en: Chern--Simons perturbations introduce corrections to soft theorems for gauge theories at subleading $\mathcal{O}\left(ω^0\right)$ order in soft momenta. We investigate these soft theorems in flat spacetime with perturbative $1/\ell^2$ de Sitter corrections. Following previous works, we define the perturbative scattering matrix in a compact region in the static patch of de Sitter. We start with computing the soft theorem for an $n$-gluon amplitude in pure Yang--Mills. We then add a Chern--Simons perturbation and compute the correction to the subleading soft theorem. We show that Chern--Simons corrections do not mix with the $1/\ell^2$ de Sitter curvature corrections at subleading order $\mathcal{O}\left(ω^0\right)$. Alternatively, one can say that the subleading Chern--Simons soft factors are insensitive to the de Sitter curvature at this order, indicating their topological nature at the level of amplitudes. This also suggests a universal behavior of these Chern--Simons soft factors.
